# javap -c -p excerpts for world-sources.json rule grass-tinder's shears claim ("by hand or with any tool except
# shears"), from the pinned RotN 3.3.4 server pack zip (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205). Extracted to a scratch folder
# outside the repo; nothing was run. Read by packages/rotn-data/test/grass-tinder.test.js.
#
# Jars (SHA-256):
#   minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar                 fe1f9274e6dad9191bf6e6e8e36ee6ebc737f373603df0946aafcded0d53167e
#   libraries/.../forge-1.12.2-14.23.5.2860.jar cd3fbf85d7ca744507fd6a37a41b90122d43e616a4f8962332b1b658655e8a64
#
# The vanilla classes below are AFTER applying Forge's server binpatch (binpatches.pack.lzma in the Forge jar;
# see fixtures/stick-sources-3.3.4/stick-sources.javap.txt for the steps); each patch's input Adler-32 matched the
# shipped class. Names come from the Forge jar's deobfuscation_data-1.12.2.lzma (notch -> SRG), in "## SRG".
#
# What it shows: breaking a block, the server's tryHarvestBlock (or.b) asks the held item's onBlockStartBreak first
# and returns without harvesting when it says true. ItemShears.onBlockStartBreak (ajl) says true for an IShearable
# block whose isShearable is true: it spawns onSheared's drops, damages the shears and sets the block to air. So
# harvestBlock, dropBlockAsItem and Forge's HarvestDropsEvent (where Dropt adds its drops) never run. Tall grass
# (aun) is always shearable; a double plant (aqb) is shearable on its LOWER half when its variant is GRASS or FERN.

## SRG
CL: ain net/minecraft/item/Item
CL: ajl net/minecraft/item/ItemShears
CL: aqb net/minecraft/block/BlockDoublePlant
CL: aun net/minecraft/block/BlockTallGrass
CL: or net/minecraft/server/management/PlayerInteractionManager
MD: or/b (Let;)Z net/minecraft/server/management/PlayerInteractionManager/func_180237_b (Lnet/minecraft/util/math/BlockPos;)Z
